column2: A short descriptive name for this analytical protocol. Should include instrument, technique, and analyte scope.
Person(s) or laboratory responsible for developing and registering this protocol.
Name of the laboratory or institution hosting the instrument.
Persistent identifier for the laboratory (e.g., ROR ID).
First date this protocol configuration was used in production.
Grants and funding that supported development of this protocol. Include grant IDs.
DOI or URL for publications or reports describing or evaluating this protocol.
Persistent identifier (DOI) assigned to this registered protocol. Enter 'pending' if a DOI has been applied for but not yet minted.
Name of the analyst who conducted the analysis session.
Date on which the analysis session began.
Date on which the analysis session ended (if spanning multiple days).
Grants and funding that supported this analytical campaign (distinct from protocol development funding). Include grant IDs.

Other analytical techniques applied to the same sample(s) whose results are intended to be interpreted together with data from this protocol. Document coupling with any technique whose results are functionally linked to this dataset (e.g., providing calibration inputs, complementary spatial context, or required companion measurements).

Describes (1) the functional relationship between this dataset and the coupled technique — what data or context flows between them — and (2) the analytical sequence — which technique was performed first and why. Required when Coupled Technique(s) is not 'None'.
DOI of the registered protocol for the coupled technique.
DOI of the dataset or publication containing the coupled technique data. If coupling is documented only through a shared sample IGSN (Group 2), this field may be 'None'.
